name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-iv-we-are-in-the-endgame-now-within-the-giant-remix
title: Final Fantasy IV - We Are In The Endgame Now! ~ Within the Giant (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Within The Giant from Final Fantasy II IV. I've finally decided to do not only my first ever mainline Final Fantasy theme remix, but also a remix of one of the best songs you could ever put in a finale for... anything because THIS SONG IS POWERFUL!!!

Perfect song for situations where Dr. Strange is on another planet talking about how they're all in the endgame after Thanos defeats them or something like that.

Important:
There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. G Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. F# Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. Enables Voice Clip, but at the cost disables "bonus end" (Voice Enabled, turned on default)
2. Disables Voice Clip (Voice Disabled)
